messages:
liam: Heads-up — after the driver/CUDA rollout to 535.12 on the eu-west H100 pool we're seeing a sustained throughput drop on some nodes, not full failures but 3-5x slower NCCL allreduce.
infra-bot: Alert: 6 nodes in eu-west2 reported topology mismatch post-rollout (driver_version=535.12 != ds_version=535.11) :warning:
sam: Can you paste the NCCL logs? curious if it's NVSwitch not being detected or a fallback to ring.
liam: Logs show NCCL picks 'ring' on affected hosts. snippet:
```
NCCL INFO AllReduce using ring algorithm
NCCL WARN Topology: NVSWITCH not present or disabled, building tree
```
sam: That smells like GPU topology info not surfaced to kube (node labels / cuda topology discovery). Did kubelet/driver DS pick up all device attributes?
olivia: We also saw node labels mismatch in one cluster after the node-image change. run:
```
kubectl get nodes -L nvidia.com/gpu-product,nvidia.com/nvlink
```
liam: On affected nodes that returns `H100` but `nvidia.com/nvlink=false`. Canary nodes (old driver) show `true`.
maya: Autoscaler is reacting — pods are moved to different node pools because perf probes fail -> more churn and cost spike. We saw ~12% cost increase on batch jobs this morning.
deploy-bot: Canary report: driver rollout 535.12 -> 535.11 rollback flagged on 3/4 canaries passed, 1 failed (eu-west2-a)
sam: Possible root causes: driver binary mismatch vs kernel module, or the user-space libs exposed different topology API (cudaDriverGetDeviceAttribute returning stale NVLink flags). Check /var/log/nvidia-driver-install.log and `nvidia-smi topo -m` on host.
liam: On the failing host `nvidia-smi topo -m` prints a flat PCI connectivity map (no NVSwitch rows). Kernel module version: 535.12-rc, but ds reports libcuda 535.11.
olivia: Quick mitigation: add admission check to prefer nodes where `nvidia.com/nvlink=true` for critical batch queues and pin canary group back to 535.11 until we validate.
maya: Agree — I started a repro job pinned to the canary pool and opened infra ticket INF-7248 to coordinate with driver vendor.
sam: If we can, rolling the driver DS back for eu-west2-a only would be least disruption. Otherwise we need to relabel nodes after a node-restart to re-run topology probe.
liam: Plan: 1) hold rollout (pause cluster roll), 2) roll back DS on eu-west2-a to 535.11, 3) run `nvidia-smi topo -m` and `kubectl label` reconciliation, 4) re-run a 20% perf canary for NCCL throughput. I'll own the rollback.
maya: Thanks — tagging compute oncall. I'll watch autoscaler and cancel noisy scale-ups.
infra-bot: Action created: INF-7248 assigned to liam. ETA 30m :clipboard:
deploy-bot: Note: Jobs that hit fallback ring algorithm will show longer completion time; consider extending job timeouts during rollback window.
liam: Updating INF-7248 with logs and exact node list. Will update here when rollback complete.
maya: PTR: also check switch firmware / cabling if rollback doesn't restore NVLink detection — we had a rare case of bad cable earlier.
liam: Good call. If rollback doesn't help we'll loop in hw vendor. For now pausing rollout. :lock:
